name: The Anup Engineering Limited
summary: The Anup Engineering Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering products in India and internationally. The company is also involved in manufacturing and fabrication of process equipment. In addition, it offers static process equipment, including heat exchangers, reactors, pressure vessels, columns and towers, and custom fabrication products; technology products, such as helix changers, EMBaffle heat exchangers, and polymerization reactors; and industrial centrifuges, as well as pre-fabrication engineering services for static process equipment.
